project_specification.overview: StyleVault is a free email-gated gallery of 12 professional UI design systems with 25 curated color palettes. Users enter their name and email on a landing page, then gain access to browse all 12 styles with live component previews, color swatches, typography details, and one-click downloads of complete style sheets in CSS, Tailwind, and JSON formats. Includes an AI-powered screenshot analyzer that extracts design tokens from uploaded images. Built as a static React app with Supabase for email storage and download analytics, designed as a lead-magnet giveaway for a live class.

frontend.routing: React Router v7 (HashRouter for static hosting)
frontend.animations: Framer Motion for page transitions and card interactions

backend.database: Supabase PostgreSQL - leads, download_events, extraction_events tables
backend.auth: None - localStorage flag after email submission
backend.edge_functions: Supabase Edge Function for screenshot analysis (calls Claude Sonnet vision API)

deployment.hosting: Static site (Vercel, Netlify, or Cloudflare Pages)
deployment.build: vite build produces static dist/ folder

communication.api: Supabase JS client for database operations, Edge Function for AI analysis

prerequisites.environment_setup: - Node.js 20+ installed - npm package manager - Supabase project with anon key (free tier) - Environment variable: VITE_SUPABASE_URL - Environment variable: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY - Environment variable: VITE_ANTHROPIC_PROXY_URL (for screenshot extractor Edge Function) - Supabase Edge Function deployed for screenshot analysis - Anthropic API key stored as Supabase Edge Function secret (never exposed to client) - Google Fonts loaded: Inter, Space Grotesk, DM Sans, Nunito, Quicksand, Orbitron, Space Mono, JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Lora, Merriweather

core_features.infrastructure: - Dev server starts and renders the React 19 app with Vite 7 and TypeScript without errors - Supabase client connects to the hosted PostgreSQL database using VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY - Supabase leads table accepts INSERT operations and persists data across page reloads - App contains no mock data, placeholder arrays, or hardcoded dummy responses for Supabase operations - All Supabase client operations (submitLead, trackDownload) query the real hosted database - App functions fully without Supabase when env vars are missing (all Supabase calls silently no-op) - HashRouter navigates between all routes (/, /gallery, /style/:id, /compare, /extract) without page reload - ErrorBoundary component wraps the entire app and displays a user-friendly fallback on unhandled errors - Catch-all 404 route displays "Page not found" message with link back to gallery
core_features.style_data: - Style data module exports TypeScript interfaces: ColorTokens, Typography, Components, Spacing, TailwindConfig, StyleData - getStyleById(id) returns the correct style object for any of 12 valid style IDs - getStylesByCategory('Core') returns 8 Core styles, getStylesByCategory('Vibe') returns 4 Vibe styles - getAllStyles() returns all 12 styles in display order (Flat Design through Warmer Shades) - Each style object contains complete token data: brand colors, surface colors, text hierarchy, border tokens, typography with font family and size scale, component patterns for cards/buttons/inputs, spacing system, and tailwind config - Each style object includes descriptive metadata: name, id, category, description, bestFor text, philosophy quote, and do's/don'ts guidelines - Palette data module exports 25 color palette objects with 6 functional color slots each: brand, background, surface, text, accent, muted - Each palette object includes id, name, category label, vibe description, and tier field ('free' for 1-10, 'premium' for 11-25) - applyPalette(styleTokens, palette) utility merges palette colors into a style's token set while preserving typography, spacing, and component structure
core_features.email_gate: - AccessContext provider reads localStorage 'sv_access' key on app mount and exposes hasAccess state - User calling grantAccess() sets localStorage flag 'sv_access' and updates React context state - ProtectedRoute component redirects unauthenticated users to landing page via React Router Navigate - User cannot access /gallery, /style/:id, /compare, or /extract routes without passing the email gate - Returning user with existing localStorage flag can navigate directly to /gallery without re-entering email
core_features.landing_page: - User sees hero section with headline "12 Professional UI Design Systems - Free" in Display typography (48px, weight 600) - User sees subtitle explaining these are ready-to-use design tokens for colors, typography, spacing, and component patterns - User can enter name and email in the capture form and click "Get Free Access" submit button - System validates both fields as required and shows inline error messages below each empty field - System validates email format with regex and shows specific error for invalid email - Submit button displays loading spinner during submission with minimum 500ms delay for perceived feedback - System stores lead in Supabase leads table, grants access, and redirects user to /gallery on successful submit - System completes email submission even if Supabase insert fails (fire-and-forget, does not block UX) - User sees preview strip below hero with 3-4 mini style cards in horizontal scroll (each ~160px wide with style name and 4 color dots) - User sees "What You Get" section with 3 feature cards (Design Tokens, Tailwind Configs, Component Patterns) with Lucide icons - User sees social proof bar "Join 500+ developers using these design systems" centered below features - User sees footer with minimal branding, copyright, and current year - Returning user with existing access sees "Go to Gallery" button alongside the email form
core_features.style_gallery: - User sees all 12 style cards displayed in a responsive CSS grid on the gallery page - System renders grid as 3 columns on desktop (lg:1024px+), 2 columns on tablet (md:768px), 1 column on mobile - User can switch between All (12 styles), Core (8 styles), and Vibe (4 styles) using filter tabs at top - User sees style name as H3 heading with category badge pill on each StyleCard ("Core" in gray, "Vibe" in purple) - User sees row of 6 color swatches (24px diameter circles with border for light colors) on each StyleCard - User sees compact StylePreview rendered with that style's actual design tokens on each StyleCard - User sees one-line description truncated with text ellipsis overflow on each StyleCard - User sees "Best for" text in muted color below description on each StyleCard - User can click anywhere on a StyleCard to navigate to /style/:id detail page - System animates cards with hover effect: subtle lift (translateY -2px) and shadow increase with 200ms transition - System animates cards in with staggered fade-in on page mount using Framer Motion - User sees "Design System Gallery" title and "Quick Compare" button linking to /compare in gallery header
core_features.live_preview: - StylePreview component renders in compact mode (~200px tall) showing a single card with heading, paragraph text, and primary button - StylePreview component renders in full mode (~500px tall) showing hero section with heading + subtitle + 2 buttons, then row of 2 feature cards, then form with inputs and submit button - System renders all preview elements using pure inline CSS derived from token values (no Tailwind classes inside preview) - System sets preview container background to the style's surface-canvas color with overflow hidden and 12px border radius - System renders all text elements using the style's specified font family via inline fontFamily style - System renders buttons using the style's button tokens: background color, text color, border radius, padding, shadow - System renders cards using the style's card tokens: background, border, radius, shadow, padding - System renders inputs using the style's input tokens: background, border, radius, padding, focus ring - User sees visually distinct previews when switching between different styles (colors, fonts, and component shapes differ)
core_features.quick_compare: - User sees a 2x2 grid displaying 4 preview screenshots for the current style on the compare page - System labels quadrants: Landing (top-left), Dashboard (top-right), Settings (bottom-left), Feed (bottom-right) - User sees style name and category badge displayed prominently at top center - User sees style counter showing current position as "N / 12" at top - User can press left/right arrow keys to cycle through all 12 styles sequentially - User can click semi-transparent arrow buttons on screen edges (appear on hover) for desktop navigation - User can swipe left/right to navigate between styles on mobile touch devices - User sees dot indicators at bottom showing current position (1-12) on mobile - System applies smooth horizontal slide animation (200ms ease) between style transitions - System loads preview images from /previews/{style-id}-{page}.png (48 static PNGs: 12 styles x 4 pages) - User can click any quadrant to navigate to /style/:id full detail page - System stacks 4 images vertically at full width on mobile with swipe left/right for changing styles - System preloads adjacent style images for smooth transitions when swiping
core_features.style_detail: - System loads correct style data by extracting style ID from URL params - System shows "Style not found" message with link back to gallery when style ID is invalid or missing - User can click back button at top left to return to gallery or compare page - User sees 4 preview image thumbnails as clickable tabs in a horizontal row at top - User can click a thumbnail tab to display that preview as the main large image below - System highlights the selected tab with a visual border or ring indicator - User sees style metadata: style name (H1), category badge, and multi-line description - User sees philosophy quote rendered in a subtle blockquote with italic styling - User sees color palette as grid of 48px circle swatches with hex value labels - User can click any color swatch to copy hex value to clipboard (shows toast "Copied #XXXXXX") - User sees typography section with font family name and hierarchy table (Level, Size, Weight, Line-Height, Usage) - User sees component specs section listing card, button, and input pattern details with exact token values - User sees Do's guidelines displayed with green checkmark icons - User sees Don'ts guidelines displayed with red X icons - User can click Previous/Next navigation at page bottom to browse adjacent styles sequentially - User sees download section with heading "Download This Style" and three format buttons: CSS Variables, Tailwind Config, JSON Tokens - User can click any download button to trigger client-side file generation and browser save dialog - System switches live preview from static PNG to live-rendered StylePreview with merged tokens when a color palette is active
core_features.downloads: - System generates CSS file with all tokens as --sv-* custom properties inside a :root {} block with style name header comment - System generates Tailwind config file with a theme.extend configuration object as a JavaScript module export with header comment - System generates JSON file with the complete token object as formatted JSON including metadata (name, version, generated date) - System triggers browser download via Blob + URL.createObjectURL + programmatic link click (no server round-trip) - System tracks download events in Supabase download_events table with style_id, format, and created_at - System completes download even if Supabase analytics insert fails (fire-and-forget tracking) - System includes selected palette colors in generated files when a palette override is active (not just default style colors)
core_features.toast_notifications: - System provides showToast(message, type) function via ToastContext provider wrapping the app - User sees toast notification slide in from top-right with Framer Motion animation - System auto-dismisses toast after 2 seconds - System stacks multiple concurrent toasts vertically without overlapping - System renders toast with success (green), info (blue), and error (red) visual variants with small icon - System styles toast with Minimalism design tokens: clean border, subtle shadow, surface-base background
core_features.screenshot_extractor: - User can navigate to Extract page from gallery header "Extract from Screenshot" link - User can upload a screenshot via drag-and-drop zone or click-to-browse button (accepts .png, .jpg, .webp) - System rejects non-image files and files exceeding 5MB with descriptive error message - User sees image preview after upload with "Analyze Design" action button - System converts image to base64 and calls Supabase Edge Function 'extract-style' on analyze - Supabase Edge Function calls Claude Sonnet vision API to identify style match and extract tokens - Edge Function returns structured JSON with identified_style, confidence, extracted colors, typography guess, and component patterns - User sees matched style name with confidence percentage badges (e.g., "This looks like: Minimalism with Glassmorphism accents") - User sees extracted color palette as row of clickable swatches with hex values - User sees typography guess with detected font family and size hierarchy - User sees side-by-side comparison: uploaded screenshot (left) and closest style's live preview (right) - User can click "Browse This Style" button to navigate to the matched style's detail page - User can download extracted tokens in CSS, Tailwind, and JSON formats (uses extracted tokens, not predefined) - System enforces rate limit of 3 extractions per email per day via Supabase extraction_events table check - System shows animated progress bar with rotating status text during analysis ("Analyzing color palette...", "Detecting typography...") - System shows friendly error message with retry button when API call fails - System shows rate limit exceeded message when user has already used 3 extractions today
core_features.color_palettes: - User sees horizontally scrollable PaletteStrip with all 25 palette thumbnails on the detail page - User sees each thumbnail as a row of 6 small color circles (16px) with palette name below - System highlights the selected palette with a ring indicator - User can select "Default" option to reset to the style's built-in original colors - User can click any palette to instantly re-render the live preview with merged color tokens - System shows a small lock icon overlay on premium palettes (11-25) for free-tier users - System shows tooltip "Upgrade to unlock 15 more palettes" when user clicks a locked premium palette - System reads tier status from localStorage 'sv_tier' field (defaults to 'free') - User can click star/heart icon on each palette thumbnail to toggle favorite status - System persists favorites array in localStorage as 'sv_fav_palettes' - User can click "Show Favorites Only" toggle to filter the palette strip to favorited palettes only - System displays a small filled star badge in the corner of favorited palettes - System shows "Star some palettes to build your shortlist" when favorites toggle is on with 0 favorites - User sees palette categories as subtle section headers in the scrollable strip (Professional, Warm, Cool, Bold, Nature, Monochrome, Luxury, Playful, Muted)
core_features.responsive_design: - System renders landing page as fully responsive: stacked sections and full-width form on mobile - System adapts gallery grid from 1-col (mobile) to 2-col (tablet md:768px) to 3-col (desktop lg:1024px) - System renders detail page stacked vertically on mobile and side-by-side layout on desktop - System renders compare page as stacked images on mobile with horizontal swipe and 2x2 grid on desktop - System ensures all touch targets are minimum 44x44px on interactive elements - System sets font size minimum 16px on mobile inputs to prevent iOS zoom - System wraps palette strip to 2 rows or scrolls horizontally on mobile
core_features.polish_and_accessibility: - System wraps route outlet in Framer Motion AnimatePresence for fade page transitions (200ms) - System updates document.title dynamically on each page ("StyleVault", "StyleVault - Gallery", "StyleVault - [Style Name]") - System shows loading skeleton with shimmer animation in gallery grid during initial font loading - System displays visible focus rings on all interactive elements for keyboard tab navigation - System applies smooth scroll behavior globally - System applies card hover transitions at 200ms ease with translateY -2px and shadow increase - System applies active:scale-[0.98] feedback on button press - System displays "SV" monogram favicon in browser tab - System sets meta description and Open Graph tags in index.html for social sharing - User can navigate the entire app using keyboard only (Tab, Enter, Escape, Arrow keys) - System shows clipboard fallback toast "Could not copy - hover to see hex value" when navigator.clipboard is unavailable

tables.leads: - id (UUID, PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()) - name (TEXT, NOT NULL) - email (TEXT, NOT NULL) - source (TEXT, DEFAULT 'stylevault') - created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, DEFAULT now())
tables.download_events: - id (UUID, PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()) - style_id (TEXT, NOT NULL) - format (TEXT, NOT NULL, CHECK IN ('json', 'css', 'tailwind')) - palette_id (TEXT, nullable - tracks which palette was active during download) - created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, DEFAULT now())
tables.extraction_events: - id (UUID, PRIMARY KEY, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()) - email (TEXT, NOT NULL) - identified_style (TEXT) - confidence (NUMERIC) - created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, DEFAULT now())

api_endpoints_summary.supabase_client_operations: - INSERT leads (name, email, source) - email capture on landing page - INSERT download_events (style_id, format, palette_id) - download analytics tracking - INSERT extraction_events (email, identified_style, confidence) - extraction tracking - SELECT COUNT extraction_events WHERE email = ? AND created_at > today - rate limit check
api_endpoints_summary.supabase_edge_functions: - POST /functions/v1/extract-style - receives base64 image + email, calls Claude Sonnet vision API, returns identified style match with extracted tokens
api_endpoints_summary.static_assets: - GET /previews/{style-id}-{page}.png - 48 pre-generated preview screenshots (12 styles x 4 pages)

ui_layout.main_structure: - Minimal header: logo text "StyleVault" on left, navigation links on right (Gallery, Extract) - Header only shows navigation links after user has access (hidden on landing page) - No sidebar - clean, content-focused layouts throughout - Main content area with generous whitespace (Minimalism style)
ui_layout.landing_page_layout: Full-width vertically stacked sections: - Navbar: logo left, minimal (no navigation links on landing) - Hero: centered text, large headline (48px), subtitle, email form below - Preview strip: horizontal scroll of 3-4 mini style cards - "What You Get" section: 3 feature cards in a row (stacked on mobile) - Social proof bar: centered text with metrics - Footer: minimal branding, copyright
ui_layout.gallery_page_layout: - Sticky header: logo left, filter tabs center (All/Core/Vibe), "Quick Compare" button right - Responsive grid of style cards below header - No sidebar, no footer - full focus on the grid
ui_layout.detail_page_layout: - Back button at top left - Preview image tabs at top (4 thumbnails + large selected preview) - Palette switcher strip below preview images - Two-column layout on desktop: left (40%) metadata/tokens, right (60%) large live preview - Single column stacked on mobile: preview on top, metadata below - Download section with three format buttons - Previous/Next navigation at the very bottom
ui_layout.compare_page_layout: - Style name and counter at top center - 2x2 grid of preview images filling the viewport - Arrow navigation buttons on left/right edges (desktop) - Dot indicators at bottom (mobile) - "View Details" button at bottom
ui_layout.extract_page_layout: - Upload zone centered at top (drag-and-drop area) - Image preview below upload zone after file selected - "Analyze Design" CTA button below preview - Results section: style match banner, color swatches, typography, side-by-side comparison - Download section at bottom with three format buttons

design_system.color_palette: The app shell uses the Minimalism style: - Brand: #111827 (near-black, Apple-inspired) - Brand Light: #E5E7EB - Brand Dark: #030712 - Surface Canvas: #FFFFFF (pure white background) - Surface Base: #FFFFFF (cards) - Surface Muted: #F9FAFB (inputs, hover states) - Text Primary: #111827 (headings, key values) - Text Secondary: #6B7280 (body text, labels) - Text Tertiary: #9CA3AF (placeholders, inactive) - Border Subtle: #F3F4F6 (near-invisible dividers) - Border Default: #E5E7EB - Success: #10B981 - Error: #EF4444 - Warning: #F59E0B - Info: #6366F1
design_system.typography: - Font family: SF Pro Display, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif - Display: 48px / weight 600 / line-height 1.1 (landing hero) - H1: 32px / weight 600 / line-height 1.2 (page titles) - H2: 24px / weight 500 / line-height 1.3 (section headers) - H3: 18px / weight 500 / line-height 1.4 (card titles) - Body: 15px / weight 400 / line-height 1.7 (regular text) - Micro: 12px / weight 400 / line-height 1.5 (labels, captions)
design_system.component_patterns: - Cards: white background, 1px border #F3F4F6, 12px radius, subtle shadow, 24px padding, hover lift - Primary buttons: #111827 background, white text, 10px radius, 12px 24px padding - Secondary buttons: transparent background, 1px border #E5E7EB, 10px radius - Ghost buttons: transparent background, hover #F9FAFB, 10px radius - Inputs: #F9FAFB background, no border default, 2px focus ring #111827, 10px radius, 12px 16px padding
design_system.spacing: - Base unit: 8px - Scale: xs 4px, sm 8px, md 16px, lg 24px, xl 32px, 2xl 48px - Density: Cozy (generous whitespace, Minimalism demands breathing room)
design_system.animations: - Page transitions: 200ms fade (Framer Motion) - Card hover: 200ms ease, translateY -2px, shadow increase - Button press: active scale 0.98 - Toast: slide-in from top-right, auto-dismiss 2s - Color swatch copy: brief scale pulse - Gallery entrance: staggered fade-in on mount

ui_ux_standards.banned_patterns: - alert(), confirm(), prompt() - Use Toast notifications and modals instead - Text-only empty states - Use styled empty state with icon and helpful message - Loading states that just say "Loading..." - Use skeleton loaders with shimmer - Raw timestamps - Format as relative time where applicable - Inline styles in the app shell - Use Tailwind CSS (inline styles only inside StylePreview component)
ui_ux_standards.required_components: - Toast notification system with success/info/error variants - Loading skeleton with shimmer animation for gallery - ErrorBoundary wrapping the entire app - StylePreview with compact and full modes - PaletteStrip with favorites and tier locking - ImageUploader with drag-and-drop support - CategoryBadge pill component for Core/Vibe labels - ColorSwatch clickable circle with copy-to-clipboard
ui_ux_standards.page_patterns: - Gallery grid -> Quick Compare (quad view) or Style Detail (full view) - Style Detail: preview tabs -> metadata -> downloads - Landing -> email gate -> Gallery (one-way flow, no back to landing after access)
ui_ux_standards.feedback_protocol: - Email submit: loading spinner -> redirect to gallery (silent success) - Download: instant file save + success toast "Downloaded [filename]" - Color copy: brief toast "Copied #XXXXXX" - Screenshot analysis: progress animation -> results display - Error: toast with error message + retry option where applicable
ui_ux_standards.polish_requirements: - Text truncation with ellipsis on card descriptions - Back navigation on detail and extract pages - Hover states on all interactive cards and buttons - Focus rings on all interactive elements - Autofocus on first form input (landing page email form) - Smooth transitions between routes - Dynamic page titles
ui_ux_standards.accessibility_basics: - Focus rings visible on keyboard navigation - Escape key dismisses toasts - aria-labels on icon-only buttons (arrows, favorites, close) - Labels on all form inputs - Color contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 for text) - Touch targets minimum 44x44px

coding_standards.architecture: - One component per file, organized by type (pages/, components/, context/, lib/, data/) - Service layer: all Supabase operations in lib/ files, never called directly from components - TypeScript interfaces for all data types in data/types.ts, no 'any' types - Style data and palette data as typed constants in data/ directory - Context providers for cross-cutting concerns (AccessContext, ToastContext)
coding_standards.routing: - HashRouter for static hosting compatibility (no server-side routing needed) - Public route: / (landing page) - Protected routes: /gallery, /style/:id, /compare, /extract - ProtectedRoute wrapper handles redirect to landing page - 404 catch-all route for unknown paths
coding_standards.error_handling: - ErrorBoundary wraps entire app at root level - Supabase operations wrapped in try/catch with console.warn (fire-and-forget) - Screenshot extractor shows user-friendly error with retry button - Missing preview images show placeholder with style name - Invalid style IDs show "not found" with navigation back to gallery

key_interactions.email_capture_flow: 1. User arrives at landing page from class link 2. Sees hero headline, preview strip teasers, and email form 3. Enters name and email, clicks "Get Free Access" 4. Form validates fields (inline errors if invalid) 5. Button shows loading spinner during submission 6. Email stored in Supabase leads table (fire-and-forget) 7. localStorage flag set, redirected to /gallery with fade transition
key_interactions.style_browsing_flow: 1. User views gallery grid with 12 style cards 2. Optionally filters by Core or Vibe using tabs 3. Clicks a style card to view full details 4. Reviews metadata: colors, typography, component specs, do's and don'ts 5. Clicks color swatches to copy hex values (toast confirms) 6. Uses Previous/Next to browse more styles 7. OR enters Quick Compare to swipe through all 12 side-by-side
key_interactions.download_flow: 1. User is on a style detail page 2. Optionally selects a color palette from the palette strip 3. Clicks one of three download buttons (CSS, Tailwind, JSON) 4. File generates client-side with style tokens (plus palette override if active) 5. Browser save dialog appears, file downloads 6. Success toast confirms download 7. Download event tracked in Supabase analytics
key_interactions.screenshot_analysis_flow: 1. User navigates to /extract from gallery header 2. Uploads a screenshot via drag-and-drop or file picker 3. Image preview appears with "Analyze Design" button 4. Clicks analyze, loading animation plays with rotating status text 5. Results show: matched style with confidence, extracted colors, typography guess 6. Side-by-side comparison of uploaded image and closest style preview 7. User can download extracted tokens or navigate to matched style's detail page
key_interactions.returning_user_flow: 1. User returns to site (localStorage flag still set) 2. Landing page detects flag, shows "Go to Gallery" button alongside form 3. User clicks button or navigates directly to /gallery (access is granted)

step.title: Project Scaffolding and Core Data
step.tasks: - Initialize Vite + React 19 + TypeScript project - Install dependencies: tailwindcss v4, react-router-dom v7, lucide-react, framer-motion, @supabase/supabase-js - Configure Tailwind v4 with Minimalism design tokens - Set up HashRouter with all route definitions (/, /gallery, /style/:id, /compare, /extract) - Create page component stubs: LandingPage, GalleryPage, StyleDetailPage, ComparePage, ExtractPage - Create shared Layout component with header - Create complete TypeScript interfaces for style data structure - Implement all 12 style datasets with full token values - Create style data helper functions (getStyleById, getStylesByCategory, getAllStyles) - Add Google Fonts link to index.html

step.title: Access Gate and Supabase Integration
step.tasks: - Create Supabase client module with env var initialization and graceful no-op - Create leads service (submitLead function with fire-and-forget error handling) - Create analytics service (trackDownload function with fire-and-forget error handling) - Create .env.example with Supabase variable placeholders - Create AccessContext provider with localStorage check and grantAccess function - Create ProtectedRoute wrapper with redirect to landing - Create ToastContext provider with showToast function - Create Toast component with slide-in animation and auto-dismiss

step.title: Landing Page and Live Preview Engine
step.tasks: - Build landing page hero section with Display typography headline and subtitle - Build email capture form with name/email inputs, validation, and submit handler - Wire form to Supabase submitLead and AccessContext grantAccess - Build preview strip with mini style cards in horizontal scroll - Build "What You Get" section with feature cards and Lucide icons - Build social proof bar and footer - Build StylePreview component with compact and full render modes - Implement tokensToStyles helper for mapping tokens to CSS properties - Add returning user detection ("Go to Gallery" button when access exists)

step.title: Gallery and Download System
step.tasks: - Build StyleCard component with color swatches, compact preview, metadata - Build gallery page with responsive grid and filter tabs (All/Core/Vibe) - Add card hover animations and staggered entrance animation - Wire card clicks to navigate to style detail page - Build CSS generator for --sv-* custom properties - Build Tailwind config generator for theme.extend object - Build JSON generator with complete token object and metadata - Build triggerDownload utility with Blob + URL.createObjectURL - Create downloadStyle orchestrator that generates, downloads, and tracks

step.title: Quick Compare and Style Detail Pages
step.tasks: - Build Compare page with 2x2 preview grid - Add swipe/arrow navigation with style cycling - Add keyboard listener for arrow keys - Add touch swipe detection for mobile - Add slide transition animation and dot indicators - Build Style Detail page with preview tabs and large preview area - Build metadata sections: colors with copy, typography table, component specs, do's/don'ts - Build download section with three format buttons - Build Previous/Next style navigation - Handle invalid style ID with "not found" state

step.title: Color Palette System
step.tasks: - Create 25 palette definitions in data/palettes.ts with tier field - Build PaletteStrip component with scrollable thumbnails - Implement palette selection with live preview re-rendering - Build favorites system with localStorage persistence - Add "Show Favorites Only" toggle with empty state message - Add premium tier lock icons with upgrade tooltip - Wire palette selection to download system (include active palette in generated files) - Add palette category section headers

step.title: Screenshot Style Extractor
step.tasks: - Build Extract page with upload zone layout - Build ImageUploader component with drag-and-drop and file validation - Create extractor service calling Supabase Edge Function - Create Supabase Edge Function extract-style with Claude Sonnet vision API call - Build results display: style match, confidence, extracted colors, typography - Build side-by-side comparison view - Wire download buttons to use extracted tokens - Add rate limiting check against extraction_events table - Add loading animation with rotating status text - Add error handling with retry button

step.title: Polish and Responsive Design
step.tasks: - Add Framer Motion page transitions to all routes - Add dynamic document.title on every page - Add loading skeleton with shimmer for gallery - Verify responsive design on all breakpoints (375px, 768px, 1024px, 1920px) - Verify all touch targets are 44x44px minimum - Add favicon, meta description, and Open Graph tags - Audit keyboard navigation and focus rings - Full end-to-end test: landing -> email -> gallery -> detail -> download - Fix any console errors or TypeScript warnings

success_criteria.functionality: - Email capture form validates, submits, and grants gallery access - All 12 styles display with correct colors, typography, and previews in gallery - Gallery filter tabs correctly show All/Core/Vibe subsets - Quick Compare allows swiping through all 12 styles with smooth transitions - Style Detail shows complete metadata, preview tabs, and color copy functionality - Downloads generate valid CSS, Tailwind, and JSON files with correct token values - Color palette switcher re-renders preview and modifies download output - Palette favorites persist across browser sessions via localStorage - Screenshot extractor uploads image, calls API, and displays analysis results - Rate limiting prevents more than 3 extractions per email per day - Returning users bypass email form with localStorage flag detection
success_criteria.user_experience: - Responsive on mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1024px+) - Page transitions are smooth with Framer Motion fade animations - All user actions provide immediate visual feedback (loading spinners, toasts, hover states) - Gallery cards have staggered entrance animation and hover lift effect - Color swatch copy shows instant toast confirmation - Download triggers instantly (client-side generation, no server round-trip for style files) - Touch targets are comfortable on mobile (44x44px minimum) - Font loading does not cause visible layout shift (skeleton placeholders)
success_criteria.technical_quality: - Zero console errors in production build - TypeScript strict mode with no 'any' types - All style data hardcoded with complete token values (no placeholder or mock data) - Supabase operations fail gracefully (app works fully without Supabase configured) - Pure inline styles inside StylePreview (no Tailwind dependency for preview rendering) - Clean component architecture: pages, components, context, lib, data separation - Service layer pattern: all Supabase calls in lib/ files, never in components - All form inputs have proper validation before submission
